sloka: तावुत्थाप्य महावीर्यौ गरुडो वासवोपमौ ।उभौ तौ सस्वजे हृष्टौ रामश्चैनमुवाच ह ।। ६.५०.४१ ।।।।
transliteration: tāvutthāpya mahāvīryau garuḍo vāsavopamau ।ubhau tau sasvaje hṛṣṭau rāmaścainamuvāca ha ।। 6.50.41 ।।।।

translations.english: Raising up both the princes who were extraordinarily brilliant and equalled Indra, Garuda embraced Rama joyfully and thus spoke.
